question_text: A boat travels 30 km downstream in 2 hours. The return trip upstream takes 3 hours. Find the speed of the current.

hint_ladder.title: Downstream: Boat plus current
hint_ladder.text: Boat speed + current = 30 km / 2 h = 15 km/h. Isipin mong tulin na may tulong ng agos.

hint_ladder.title: Upstream: Boat minus current
hint_ladder.text: Boat speed - current = 30 km / 3 h = 10 km/h. Ito naman ay laban sa agos.

hint_ladder.title: Current = Half ng difference
hint_ladder.text: Current speed = (15 - 10)/2 = 5/2 = 2.5 km/h. Kalahati ng pinagkaiba ng dalawang bilis.

hint_ladder.title: Sagot: 2.5 km/h
hint_ladder.text: Kaya ang sagot ay 2.5 km/h. Option B ang tama.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you divided 5 by 2.5 instead of 2, resulting in 2 km/h.

B.text: Correct. Downstream speed = 15 km/h, upstream = 10 km/h; current = (15 - 10)/2 = 2.5 km/h.

C.text: You might have chosen C because you rounded up or incorrectly applied the formula, getting 3 instead of 2.5.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you added 15+10=25, then divided by 7, getting ~3.5 km/h.

next_time_rule: Next time: Current = (Downstream - Upstream) / 2. Downstream = boat + current, upstream = boat - current. Kaya mo 'yan!
deconstruct_text:
Alam mo ba? Sa probinsya, yung mga bangkero sa Ilog Pasig ay araw-araw na lumalaban sa agos. Ganito rin sa exam: imagine a banca from Guadalupe to Binondo, 30 km ang layo. Downstream, 2 hours lang, kasi tulong ang agos. Upstream, 3 hours, kasi laban sa agos.

Kunin natin ang bilis: Downstream speed = 30 km / 2 h = 15 km/h. Ito ay speed ng bangka plus speed ng current. Upstream speed = 30 km / 3 h = 10 km/h. Ito ay speed ng bangka minus current.

Ngayon, isipin mong equation: Boat + Current = 15, Boat - Current = 10. Pag in-add mo, 2Boat = 25, kaya Boat = 12.5 km/h. Tapos, subtract mo: (Boat+Current) - (Boat-Current) = 15 - 10, so 2Current = 5, Current = 2.5 km/h.

Kaya ang tamang sagot ay 2.5 km/h, Option B. Tandaan: Downstream = dagdag, Upstream = bawas.

**Watch-Out Zone: reverse_operation_error** Don't add; subtract speeds, then half.
